nodes.summary: For an instance $(n, E, k, F)$, the host graph is the graph of the edge list $E$ on $n$ vertices: the simple graph on $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ in which distinct vertices $i$ and $j$ are adjacent when $(i, j)$ or $(j, i)$ belongs to $E$.
nodes.title: Host graph of an induced-subgraph-isomorphism instance

nodes.summary: For an instance $(n, E, k, F)$, the pattern graph is the graph of the edge list $F$ on $k$ vertices: the simple graph on $\{0, \dots, k - 1\}$ in which distinct vertices $i$ and $j$ are adjacent when $(i, j)$ or $(j, i)$ belongs to $F$.
nodes.title: Pattern graph of an induced-subgraph-isomorphism instance

nodes.summary: The decision problem INDUCED SUBGRAPH ISOMORPHISM accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to an instance $(n, E, k, F)$ (host vertex count, host edge list, pattern vertex count, pattern edge list) that is well-formed and for which there is an injective map $f$ from $\{0, \dots, k - 1\}$ to $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ such that, for all $a$ and $b$, the vertices $a$ and…
nodes.title: INDUCED SUBGRAPH ISOMORPHISM as a decision problem

nodes.summary: An instance $(n, E, k, F)$ is feasible when there is an injective map $f$ from $\{0, \dots, k - 1\}$ to $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ such that, for all $a, b \in \{0, \dots, k - 1\}$, the vertices $a$ and $b$ are adjacent in the pattern graph if and only if $f(a)$ and $f(b)$ are adjacent in the host graph.
nodes.title: Induced embedding of the pattern into the host

nodes.summary: An instance of INDUCED SUBGRAPH ISOMORPHISM is a quadruple $(n, E, k, F)$ consisting of a natural number $n$ (the number of host vertices), a list $E$ of pairs of natural numbers (the host edges), a natural number $k$ (the number of pattern vertices) and a list $F$ of pairs of natural numbers (the pattern edges).
nodes.title: Induced-subgraph-isomorphism instance

nodes.summary: The decision problem INDUCED SUBGRAPH ISOMORPHISM is in NP, and every decision problem in NP reduces to it by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: INDUCED SUBGRAPH ISOMORPHISM is NP-complete

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
